plan.rationale:
A byte-bounded frozen ranked preseed in the unchanged native A+ bank can improve initial and subsequent decode residency and reduce demand refill/file refault/read pressure while ordinary LRU and victims remain intact. Larger feasible nomination subsets are allowed within actual grants and the 60GiB inclusive ceiling. Test this one source policy at the same A+ budget/share; use native decode counters and cold/warm phase-separated measurements, not prefill-copy extrapolation.

Required new aplus-calibration-fault-io-report.json reports substantial advancing decode-window refault/read pressure and no TTFT. It changes revision1's prefill-led emphasis. stock-native-replay-three-sizes.json supports capacity sensitivity only as simulation; routing-residency-counterfactual-report.json supports modeled sizing/byte opportunity only. frozen-strata-top192-ranked-pool.json and cache-operator-byte-bounded-candidate-pool replace the literal top96-only restriction with deterministic admission inside actual grants and 60GiB including overhead; full top192 exceeds the ceiling. incoming-p1-reference-report.md, incoming-c1-functional-report.md and incoming-c1-functional-report-v2.md were read in full: retain reconnaissance limitations, prefill-only hook scope and replay variability without deriving decode speedup. operator-native-bank-hypothesis.md and operator-cache-source-options.md justify using existing native backing and ordinary victims instead of an independent strict-A pool. Owner contract input-0:star-deepseek-v1.json/input-1:star-deepseek-v1.md, previous-cache-decision-8.json and next-do-planner-boundary.md preserve independent legacy/scorer scope, measured controls and separate DO handoff; current reopen steering supersedes the former hold. Current cc_list and passive native_profile/verifier materials show 1.3.0 is now available, superseding revision1's unavailable-verifier assumption.
plan.summary: Generation still read expert data from storage, so the next plan loads frequently used experts into the existing cache first and lets later requests replace them.

report.summary: At 60 GiB, C3 decoded 6.8× and 7.1× as fast as A-matched at 512 and 2048 tokens, while median time to first token rose to 5.2× and 5.3×.
